blocking_defect.defect: navfm.probe_adjudication._identity_matches accepts a returned collider by raw string prefix in either direction, with no path-segment boundary. A prim named '/W/WallLamp' is therefore accepted as identity for declared target '/W/Wall'.
blocking_defect.status_today: PRE-EXISTING, not introduced here. It is latent at section granularity because declared paths are long and specific.
blocking_defect.why_it_blocks_H2: owner-granularity selection makes declared targets SHORTER prefixes, so the set of prims that can false-accept grows. Adopting H2 on top of prefix matching would weaken identity, which is the opposite of the intent.
blocking_defect.required_repair_before_any_selection_cha: identity by explicit component membership, or prefix matching that respects path-segment boundaries. Preregister and test before adopting, with G as the negative control.

decision_rationale: H2 is supported as a SELECTION-GRANULARITY option and is the only hypothesis that resolves the self-conflict, but it is not adoptable as a hierarchy rule. Same-parent grouping fails on counterexamples, and the existing frozen contract already requires ownership to be preregistered rather than inferred. Adoption is additionally blocked by IDENTITY-PREFIX-1.
amendment_blocked_by: no declared ownership source for Hospital walls
generalisation evidence covers 1.9% of the scene

if_adopted_the_rules_would_be.selection: the declared physical owner is the blocker unit; its components are declared pre-query
if_adopted_the_rules_would_be.competitor_exclusion: exclude the target and all preregistered components of its owner; exclude nothing on path or string similarity
if_adopted_the_rules_would_be.identity: returned collider is in declared_owner.component_paths — membership, not prefix
if_adopted_the_rules_would_be.rejected_design: declare Section0, hit Section1, accept because the parent matches. That discovers ownership after observing the result.

identity_strength_if_adopted: UNCHANGED to STRONGER, provided IDENTITY-PREFIX-1 is repaired first; WEAKER if adopted on top of prefix matching
targetability_code_changes_required: NONE — targetability.decide is sound and passed 6/6 controls
correction_locus: target selection and competitor construction, upstream of targetability
wrong_1: UNRESOLVED. Establishing that previous probes asked the wrong physical-unit question does not establish which collider physically caused wrong_1.
non_claims: same parent means same physical owner
claim_boundary: Establishes where the defect is and what ownership would have to mean. Selects no scene, changes no semantics, and authorises no amendment.
